say:1:1621808001:1.text: We did it! The Hypofiends are gone!
say:1:1621808001:1.source_cn: 好棒，我们做到了！我们把那些魔物都解决掉了！

say:2:1621808002:1.text: We've uncovered the truth behind the attacks and saved Hausburg. Is this the end of our adventure?
say:2:1621808002:1.source_cn: 真相已经调查清楚，豪斯镇的危机也已经解决。这样一来，这...

say:6:1621808005:0.text: I'm a Hypogean, the very cause of the Hypofiend attacks.
say:6:1621808005:0.source_cn: 我是恶魔，是引发魔物袭击的源头。

say:7:1621808006:0.text: Don't fret. All you have to do is seal me away.
say:7:1621808006:0.source_cn: 别一副紧张的模样，你们要做的很简单，封印我就好了。

choice_prompt:8:1621808006.text: Don't fret. All you have to do is seal me away.
choice_prompt:8:1621808006.source_cn: 别一副紧张的模样，你们要做的很简单，封印我就好了。

say:10:1621808007:1.text: That's just the way things are. Hypogeans are meant to be sealed by humans.
say:10:1621808007:1.source_cn: 为什么？因为人类就是要封印恶魔，恶魔就是要被人类封印。

say:11:1621808008:1.text: Since the secret society has beaten a hasty retreat, there's no reason for me to stay here.
say:11:1621808008:1.source_cn: 反正秘密结社的人都撤走了，我留下来也没有意义。

say:12:1621808009:1.text: I haven't given up revenge, though. When I break free of my seal, I'll settle the score with that president!
say:12:1621808009:1.source_cn: 但我会记着这件事……等我再次突破封印，一定要找那个会长复仇！

say:13:1621808010:1.text: The grudge is between him and me alone. Now, go ahead and seal me. I won't fight back.
say:13:1621808010:1.source_cn: 好了，这些事与你们无关。动手吧，我不会反抗。

say:16:1621808012:1.text: The Hypogean closes her eyes. What seems like a choice born of despair is, in fact, a moment of relief.
say:16:1621808012:1.source_cn: 你看着眼前的恶魔，她已经闭上了眼睛。放弃希望、走向自毁...
say:16:1621808012:1.male: The Hypogean closes her eyes. What seems like a choice born of despair is, in fact, a moment of relief.
say:16:1621808012:1.female: The Hypogean closes her eyes. What seems like a choice born of despair is, in fact, a moment of relief.

say:17:1621808013:1.text: At this moment, fiction and reality overlap. Contess, also the Hypogean of rules, awaits your decision.
say:17:1621808013:1.source_cn: 故事与现实逐渐重叠。康缇丝——规则之恶魔——在其中凝视着你。
say:17:1621808013:1.male: At this moment, fiction and reality overlap. Contess, also the Hypogean of rules, awaits your decision.
say:17:1621808013:1.female: At this moment, fiction and reality overlap. Contess, also the Hypogean of rules, awaits your decision.

say:18:1621808014:1.text: In the story of Hausburg, the Hypogean shows no hostility toward humanity and has even given you great assistance. With strict oversight, she could become your formidable ally.
say:18:1621808014:1.source_cn: 在豪斯镇的故事中，这只恶魔似乎对人类没什么恶意，还帮了...
say:18:1621808014:1.male: In the story of Hausburg, the Hypogean shows no hostility toward humanity and has even given you great assistance. With strict oversight, she could become your formidable ally.
say:18:1621808014:1.female: In the story of Hausburg, the Hypogean shows no hostility toward humanity and has even given you great assistance. With strict oversight, she could become your formidable ally.

say:19:1621808015:1.text: Meanwhile, the villainous secret society remains at large. Since you share a common foe with the Hypogean, it is wiser to make an ally of her rather than an adversary.
say:19:1621808015:1.source_cn: 而最大的幕后黑手——秘密结社依旧逍遥法外。你们有共同的...
say:19:1621808015:1.male: Meanwhile, the villainous secret society remains at large. Since you share a common foe with the Hypogean, it is wiser to make an ally of her rather than an adversary.
say:19:1621808015:1.female: Meanwhile, the villainous secret society remains at large. Since you share a common foe with the Hypogean, it is wiser to make an ally of her rather than an adversary.

choice_prompt:20:1621808015.text: Meanwhile, the villainous secret society remains at large. Since you share a common foe with the Hypogean, it is wiser to make an ally of her rather than an adversary.
choice_prompt:20:1621808015.source_cn: 而最大的幕后黑手——秘密结社依旧逍遥法外。你们有共同的敌人，多一个强大的帮手，当然比多一个不确定的对手要好。
choice_prompt:20:1621808015.male: Meanwhile, the villainous secret society remains at large. Since you share a common foe with the Hypogean, it is wiser to make an ally of her rather than an adversary.
choice_prompt:20:1621808015.female: Meanwhile, the villainous secret society remains at large. Since you share a common foe with the Hypogean, it is wiser to make an ally of her rather than an adversary.

say:24:1621808017:1.text: A Hypogean-human alliance... to bring down the secret society?
say:24:1621808017:1.source_cn: 恶魔与人类合作……一起对付秘密结社？

say:25:1621808018:1.text: For this cause... very well, I'm on board. I'll mark our alliance on the first page of the rulebook, and it shall remain binding forever.
say:25:1621808018:1.source_cn: 为了这个目的……好，我答应你。我会把这条协议写在规则书...
say:25:1621808018:1.male: For this cause... very well, I'm on board. I'll mark our alliance on the first page of the rulebook, and it shall remain binding forever.
say:25:1621808018:1.female: For this cause... very well, I'm on board. I'll mark our alliance on the first page of the rulebook, and it shall remain binding forever.

say:26:1621808019:1.text: Of course, the villagers of Hausburg need to be fine with our alliance. I'll leave it to you to convince them.
say:26:1621808019:1.source_cn: 当然，前提是豪斯镇的人同意。我看辩论吵架的事就交给你吧？
say:26:1621808019:1.male: Of course, the villagers of Hausburg need to be fine with our alliance. I'll leave it to you to convince them.
say:26:1621808019:1.female: Of course, the villagers of Hausburg need to be fine with our alliance. I'll leave it to you to convince them.

say:27:1621808020:1.text: Don't stress about it too much, alright? If you fail, I'll just get sealed—no big deal. As long as I'm alive, I'll get my chance at revenge someday.
say:27:1621808020:1.source_cn: 别太有负担，失败了也没什么，大不了就是被封印……只要不...
say:27:1621808020:1.male: Don't stress about it too much, alright? If you fail, I'll just get sealed—no big deal. As long as I'm alive, I'll get my chance at revenge someday.
say:27:1621808020:1.female: Don't stress about it too much, alright? If you fail, I'll just get sealed—no big deal. As long as I'm alive, I'll get my chance at revenge someday.

choice_prompt:28:1621808020.source_cn: 别太有负担，失败了也没什么，大不了就是被封印……只要不死，我总会找到复仇的机会。
choice_prompt:28:1621808020.male: Don't stress about it too much, alright? If you fail, I'll just get sealed—no big deal. As long as I'm alive, I'll get my chance at revenge someday.
choice_prompt:28:1621808020.female: Don't stress about it too much, alright? If you fail, I'll just get sealed—no big deal. As long as I'm alive, I'll get my chance at revenge someday.

say:30:1621808021:0.text: Let's find the <style="highlight">mayor</style> first and let him know the Hypofiends are gone.
say:30:1621808021:0.male: Let's find the <style="highlight">mayor</style> first and let him know the Hypofiends are gone.
say:30:1621808021:0.female: Let's find the <style="highlight">mayor</style> first and let him know the Hypofiends are gone.

choice:28:1:2.text: I'll ask the villagers what they think.
choice:28:1:2.male: I'll ask the villagers what they think.
choice:28:1:2.female: I'll ask the villagers what they think.

choice:23:0:1.source_cn: 你必须全力为我提供协助……<key:dialog1>

choice:23:0:1.female: You'll give me your full support...

choice:23:1:2.text: You'll stay in Hausburg under my supervision.
choice:23:1:2.source_cn: 你要接受管控，留在豪斯镇
choice:23:1:2.male: You'll stay in Hausburg under my supervision.
choice:23:1:2.female: You'll stay in Hausburg under my supervision.

choice:20:0:1.text: I don't have to seal you.
choice:20:0:1.male: I don't have to seal you.
